description: Irrigation Water Productivity in Africa is a dataset listed in Joint Research Centre, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Joint Research Centre. The dataset provides geolocalized (Long-Lat).csv files and shapefiles with yields for four different cereals (maize, millet, rice and sorghum) under rain-fed and and optimal irrigation conditions. It covers all agricultural locations in Sub-Saharan Africa assuming a low use of fertilizers, resembling the actual inputs use in the region. Coverage: Joint Research Centre. The publisher named on the listing is Joint Research Centre. Its keywords include Irrigation potentials, DSSAT, Water productivity, Sub-Saharan Africa, XGBoost. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is European Commission reuse notice. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-jrc.
